questions.prompt: A cheetah is ___ a lion.
questions.explain: Short adjective: add -er, then use 'than': faster than.

questions.prompt: My bag is ___ yours. It has more books in it.
questions.explain: Consonant + y becomes -ier: heavier.

questions.prompt: This ball is ___ that one. It is a size 5.
questions.explain: One vowel + one consonant: double the consonant (bigger).

questions.prompt: Today is ___ yesterday. The sun is shining!
questions.explain: Adjective ending in -e: add only -r (nicer), then 'than'.

questions.prompt: Sara is the ___ runner in our team.
questions.explain: 'In the team' compares one with all: the + -est (fastest).

questions.prompt: Russia is the ___ country in the world.
questions.explain: Superlative of a short adjective: double the g, add -est.

questions.prompt: What is the comparative of 'hot'?
questions.explain: One vowel + one consonant: double the t (hotter).

questions.prompt: What is the comparative of 'happy'?
questions.explain: Consonant + y becomes -ier: happier.

questions.prompt: What is the superlative of 'easy'?
questions.explain: Consonant + y becomes -iest: the easiest.

questions.prompt: A plane is ___ than a train. It costs more.
questions.explain: Long adjectives take more + adjective, with no -er.

questions.prompt: This is the ___ film of the year. I loved it!
questions.explain: Long adjective in a superlative: the most + adjective.

questions.prompt: Our team is ___ than theirs. We won 5-0.
questions.explain: Good is irregular: good, better, best.

questions.prompt: Who is the ___ player in your team?
questions.explain: Superlative of good: best.

questions.prompt: Yesterday it was cold and wet. Today it is ___ than yesterday: it is snowing too!
questions.explain: Bad is irregular: bad, worse, worst.

questions.prompt: That was the ___ day of my life! I lost my phone and failed a test.
questions.explain: Superlative of bad: worst.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about heights is correct?
choices: My brother is taller than me.
My brother is more taller than me.
My brother is more tall than me.
My brother is tallest than me.
questions.answer: My brother is taller than me.
questions.explain: Never use 'more' with an -er adjective: taller, not more taller.

questions.prompt: We are both 12. I am ___ old ___ my cousin.
questions.explain: Equal things: as + adjective + as.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about two boys of the same height is correct?
choices: Tom is as tall than Ben.
Tom is as taller as Ben.
Tom is as tall as Ben.
Tom is same tall as Ben.
questions.answer: Tom is as tall as Ben.
questions.explain: Equality uses as + adjective + as (never than).

questions.prompt: She plays tennis ___ than her brother. She wins every game.
questions.explain: Comparative of the adverb well: better.

questions.prompt: Beowulf was ___ than the other warriors in the hall.
questions.explain: Short adjective: stronger than.

questions.prompt: Many people said Beowulf was the ___ warrior of all.
questions.explain: 'Of all' needs a superlative: the bravest.

questions.prompt: The giraffe is the ___ animal on Earth.
questions.explain: Superlative of a short adjective: the tallest.

questions.prompt: Sharks are ___ than goldfish.
questions.explain: Long adjective: more dangerous than.

questions.prompt: Football is more popular ___ rugby in my town.
questions.explain: Use 'than' after a comparative.

questions.prompt: First we warmed up, ___ we played the match.
questions.explain: 'Then' shows time (next); 'than' compares.

questions.prompt: Heorot was the ___ hall in the land.
questions.explain: Adjective ending in -e: add -st (the largest).

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: A mouse is ___ than a rabbit. (small)
questions.explain: Short adjective: add -er.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: Winter is ___ than autumn. (cold)
questions.explain: Short adjective: add -er.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: My brother is ___ than me. (old)
questions.explain: Short adjective: add -er.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: The Nile is the ___ river in Africa. (long)
questions.explain: Superlative of a short adjective: add -est.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: Everest is the ___ mountain in the world. (high)
questions.explain: Superlative of a short adjective: add -est.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: The blue whale is the ___ animal in the world. (big)
questions.explain: Double the g: biggest.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: Jack is a good player, but Tom is even ___ than him. (good)
questions.explain: Good is irregular: better.

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: My bike is as fast ___ yours. They are the same model.
questions.explain: Equal things: as + adjective + as.

questions.prompt: What is the comparative of 'slow'?
questions.explain: A final w is not doubled: slower.

questions.prompt: What is the comparative of 'thin'?
questions.explain: One vowel + one consonant: double the n (thinner).

questions.prompt: What is the superlative of 'wet'?
questions.explain: One vowel + one consonant: double the t (the wettest).

questions.prompt: The shopping centre is ___ on Saturdays than on Mondays.
questions.explain: Consonant + y becomes -ier: busier.

questions.prompt: This stadium is ___ than the old one.
questions.explain: Modern has two syllables but takes more: more modern.

questions.prompt: I am ___ than yesterday. I did not sleep well.
questions.explain: Adjectives ending in -ed take more: more tired.

questions.prompt: Beowulf is one of the ___ heroes in English literature.
questions.explain: Long adjective in a superlative: the most famous.

questions.prompt: My new school is ___ from home than my old one.
questions.explain: Far is irregular: far, further/farther, furthest/farthest.

questions.prompt: What is the superlative of 'bad'?
questions.explain: Bad is irregular: bad, worse, worst.

questions.prompt: Sam scored three goals and Leo scored two. Sam scored ___ goals than Leo.
questions.explain: Comparative of many/much is more.

questions.prompt: Of all the players in the league, Dan scored ___ goals.
questions.explain: Superlative of many/much is most: the most.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means the same? 'Tom is taller than Ben.'
choices: Tom isn't as tall as Ben.
Ben isn't as tall as Tom.
Ben is as tall as Tom.
questions.answer: Ben isn't as tall as Tom.
questions.explain: If Tom is taller, Ben is not as tall as Tom.

questions.prompt: Tennis is ___ dangerous than boxing. Boxing is more dangerous.
questions.explain: Less + adjective + than shows a lower degree.

questions.prompt: Of the three exercises, this one is ___ difficult. The others are harder.
questions.explain: Superlative of little: the least + adjective.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about two schools is correct?
choices: Our school isn't as bigger as yours.
Our school isn't as big as yours.
Our school isn't so bigger than yours.
Our school isn't as big than yours.
questions.answer: Our school isn't as big as yours.
questions.explain: Not as + adjective + as: the adjective stays in its base form.

questions.prompt: Dad drives ___ than Mum. He is very careful.
questions.explain: Adverbs in -ly take more: more carefully.

questions.prompt: Marta trains ___ than anyone in the team.
questions.explain: Hard is also an adverb: harder.

questions.prompt: He plays ___ now than last year. He keeps making mistakes.
questions.explain: Comparative of the adverb badly: worse.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about a class is correct?
choices: He is the most tall boy in the class.
He is the tallest boy in the class.
He is the tallest boy from the class.
He is the more tall boy in the class.
questions.answer: He is the tallest boy in the class.
questions.explain: Short adjective: the tallest (not the most tall).

questions.prompt: Which sentence about pizza is correct?
choices: This is the goodest pizza in town.
This is the most good pizza in town.
This is the best pizza in town.
This is the more good pizza in town.
questions.answer: This is the best pizza in town.
questions.explain: Superlative of good: the best.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about a cold is correct?
choices: My cold is worser today than yesterday.
My cold is more bad today than yesterday.
My cold is more worse today than yesterday.
My cold is worse today than yesterday.
questions.answer: My cold is worse today than yesterday.
questions.explain: Worse is already a comparative: no more, no -er.

questions.prompt: Hrothgar was ___ than Beowulf. Beowulf was a young man.
questions.explain: Short adjective: older than.

questions.prompt: The giant's sword was ___ than any normal sword.
questions.explain: Consonant + y becomes -ier: heavier.

questions.prompt: Beowulf was stronger than any ___ in Denmark.
questions.explain: After 'any' in a comparison, use a singular noun.

questions.prompt: The Danes thought Grendel was the ___ monster in the world.
questions.explain: Long adjective: the most terrible.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about Achilles is correct?
choices: Achilles was the fastest runner in the Greek army.
Achilles was the most fast runner in the Greek army.
Achilles was the fastest runner from the Greek army.
Achilles was the faster runner in the Greek army.
questions.answer: Achilles was the fastest runner in the Greek army.
questions.explain: Superlative + in + group: the fastest runner in the army.

questions.prompt: Mercury is the ___ planet to the Sun.
questions.explain: Close ends in -e: add -st (closest).

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: The station is ___ from here than the park. (far)
questions.explain: Both farther and further are correct.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: Odysseus was ___ than the other leaders. (clever)
questions.explain: Two-syllable adjective in -er: both forms are correct.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: This street is ___ than that one. (narrow)
questions.explain: Two-syllable adjective in -ow: both forms are correct.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: The sea is ___ at night than in the day. (quiet)
questions.explain: Two-syllable adjective in -et: both forms are correct.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: Our new coach is ___ than the old one. (friendly)
questions.explain: Consonant + y becomes -ier (friendlier); more friendly is also correct.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: A marathon is ___ than a sprint. (tiring)
questions.explain: Adjectives ending in -ing take more: more tiring.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: Sam is a bad singer, but I am even ___. (bad)
questions.explain: Bad is irregular: worse.

questions.prompt: Put the adverb in the correct form: She sings ___ than me. (well)
questions.explain: Comparative of the adverb well: better.

questions.prompt: Put the adverb in the correct form: She gets up ___ than me. (early)
questions.explain: Consonant + y becomes -ier: earlier.

questions.prompt: Put the adverb in the correct form: The turtle moves ___ than the rabbit. (slowly)
questions.explain: Adverb in -ly: more slowly (slower is also used).

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: Ben isn't ___ tall as Tom. Tom is taller.
questions.explain: Not as + adjective + as (not so ... as is also correct).

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: Lake Baikal is the deepest lake ___ the world.
questions.explain: Use 'in' with a place or group: in the world.

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: She is the oldest ___ the three sisters.
questions.explain: Use 'of' (or 'among') with a number: of the three.

questions.prompt: Beowulf was ___ stronger than the other men in the hall.
questions.explain: Before a comparative, use much / far / a lot, not 'very'.

questions.prompt: Sam is 1.61 m tall and Tom is 1.60 m. Sam is ___ taller than Tom.
questions.explain: A small difference needs slightly or a bit.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about two phones is correct?
choices: This phone is very better than that one.
This phone is much better than that one.
This phone is much more better than that one.
This phone is too better than that one.
questions.answer: This phone is much better than that one.
questions.explain: Much + comparative; never very + comparative.

questions.prompt: Our goalkeeper is by far ___ player in the league.
questions.explain: By far goes with a superlative: by far the best.

questions.prompt: Our team is getting ___. We won three matches in a row.
questions.explain: Comparative + and + comparative shows a steady change.

questions.prompt: The more you train, ___ you play.
questions.explain: The + comparative, the + comparative: the more ..., the better.

questions.prompt: The ___ you practise, the better you get.
questions.explain: The more ..., the better ...: more is the comparative.

questions.prompt: The older he gets, ___ he becomes.
questions.explain: The + comparative, the + comparative: the more patient.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about two bags is correct?
choices: This bag is twice so heavy as that one.
This bag is twice as heavy than that one.
This bag is twice more heavy as that one.
This bag is twice as heavy as that one.
questions.answer: This bag is twice as heavy as that one.
questions.explain: Twice + as + adjective + as.

questions.prompt: Heorot was three times ___ large ___ an ordinary house.
questions.explain: Multiple + as + adjective + as: three times as fast as.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about Hrothgar's hall is correct?
choices: Hrothgar's hall was one of the largest building in the land.
Hrothgar's hall was one of the largest buildings in the land.
Hrothgar's hall was one of largest buildings in the land.
Hrothgar's hall was one of the most larger buildings in the land.
questions.answer: Hrothgar's hall was one of the largest buildings in the land.
questions.explain: One of the + superlative + plural noun.

questions.prompt: Saturn is the ___ largest planet in the solar system. Only Jupiter is bigger.
questions.explain: Use an ordinal number: the second largest.

questions.prompt: We need ___ information about the tickets.
questions.explain: Further means 'more' or 'additional'; farther is only for distance.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about a boring match is correct?
choices: It was the most boringest match I have ever seen.
It was the most boring match I have ever seen.
It was most boring match I have ever seen.
It was the more boring match I have ever seen.
questions.answer: It was the most boring match I have ever seen.
questions.explain: Long adjective: the most boring (no -est as well).

questions.prompt: Which sentence about Grendel is correct?
choices: Grendel was more stronger than any warrior in Denmark.
Grendel was strongest than any warrior in Denmark.
Grendel was stronger than any warrior in Denmark.
Grendel was stronger as any warrior in Denmark.
questions.answer: Grendel was stronger than any warrior in Denmark.
questions.explain: Short adjective + -er + than.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means the same? 'No other animal on land is faster than a cheetah.'
choices: A cheetah is one of the fastest animals on land.
A cheetah is as fast as other land animals.
A cheetah is slower than other land animals.
A cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
questions.answer: A cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
questions.explain: If nothing is faster, the cheetah is the fastest.

questions.prompt: The first film was good, but the second is ___. It is the best I have seen.
questions.explain: Even + comparative adds emphasis: even better.

questions.prompt: Both teams are equally good. Our team is just ___ good ___ theirs.
questions.explain: Just as ... as stresses that two things are equal.

questions.prompt: Of all the sports, golf is ___ tiring.
questions.explain: Superlative of little: the least + adjective.

questions.prompt: Which is the opposite of 'the most dangerous'?
questions.explain: Opposite of the most: the least.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about cheese is correct?
choices: The more cheese I eat, the more I like it.
The more cheese I eat, more I like it.
The most cheese I eat, the most I like it.
More cheese I eat, the more I like it.
questions.answer: The more cheese I eat, the more I like it.
questions.explain: The more ..., the more ...

questions.prompt: Which sentence about a test is correct?
choices: This test was much difficult than the last one.
This test was much more difficult than the last one.
This test was very more difficult than the last one.
This test was more much difficult than the last one.
questions.answer: This test was much more difficult than the last one.
questions.explain: Much + more + adjective + than.

questions.prompt: Neptune is the ___ planet from the Sun.
questions.explain: Superlative of far: farthest or furthest.

questions.prompt: The giant's sword was ___ any other sword in the cave. It was very sharp.
questions.explain: A comparison with 'any other' needs comparative + than.

questions.prompt: Hercules is one of the ___ heroes in Greek stories.
questions.explain: One of the + superlative + plural noun.

questions.prompt: Which sentence about Beowulf is correct?
choices: Beowulf was more braver than all the other men.
Beowulf was braver than all the other men.
Beowulf was bravest than all the other men.
Beowulf was brave than all the other men.
questions.answer: Beowulf was braver than all the other men.
questions.explain: Comparative + than: braver than.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: The nights are getting ___ and ___. (long)
questions.explain: Repeat the comparative to show a steady change.

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: The game is getting more and ___ exciting.
questions.explain: Long adjective: more and more + adjective.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: The older he gets, the ___ he becomes. (wise)
questions.explain: The + comparative: wiser or more wise.

questions.prompt: Put the adverb in the correct form: The harder you train, the ___ you play. (well)
questions.explain: Comparative of the adverb well: better.

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: This is one of the ___ interesting books I know.
questions.explain: One of the most + adjective + plural noun.

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: Our goalkeeper is by ___ the best player in the league.
questions.explain: By far the best.

questions.prompt: Put the adjective in the correct form: K2 is the second ___ mountain in the world. (high)
questions.explain: The second + superlative: the second highest.

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: Beowulf was stronger ___ any other warrior.
questions.explain: After a comparative, use 'than'.

questions.prompt: Complete with one word: The new hall is three times bigger ___ the old one.
questions.explain: After a comparative, use 'than' (three times as big as is also correct).
